items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: The guy who had that show was named Billy Clark. Yeah, he owned the show. ... I left. Pete Jones left. And James Clark. Three of us. Just three of us left.

ctx.x: I see. Who ran the show? Who was in charge of the show?
The guy who had that show was named Billy Clark. Yeah, he owned the show.
So this was going on the TOBA circuit, right?
